body.note: Review started. You'll get a Teams message with the results in a few minutes, and the report will be saved to the property's Internal Review > Review Results folder.

Compose_-_Required_Files_Status.inputs:
@concat(
'Required File Validation',
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
'Folder: ',outputs('Internal_Review_Folder_Path'),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
if(equals(actions('Get_files_(properties_only)')?['status'],'Failed'),'FOLDER NOT FOUND (0 files)',concat(outputs('Compose_1'),' files')),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
outputs('Compose_-_BSSS_Result'),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
outputs('Compose_-_TB_Result'),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
outputs('Compose_-_T12_Result'),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
outputs('Compose_-_BC_Result'),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
outputs('Compose_-_BS_Result'),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
outputs('Compose_-_GL_Result'),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
outputs('Compose_-_PM_Fee_Result'),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
outputs('Compose_-_Mortgage_Result'),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
outputs('Compose_-_Bank_Rec_Result'),
decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
if(
and(
contains(outputs('Compose_-_BSSS_Result'),'FOUND'),
contains(outputs('Compose_-_TB_Result'),'FOUND'),
contains(outputs('Compose_-_T12_Result'),'FOUND'),contains(outputs('Compose_-_BS_Result'),'FOUND'),contains(outputs('Compose_-_GL_Result'),'FOUND'),
contains(outputs('Compose_-_BC_Result'),'FOUND')
),
'STATUS: REQUIRED FILES COMPLETE',
'STATUS: REQUIRED FILES MISSING'
)
)

Sources_JSON.inputs:

json(concat('{"type":"BSSS","file":"',replace(coalesce(first(body('Filter_BSSS'))?['{FilenameWithExtension}'],''),'"',''),'","status":"',if(equals(length(body('Filter_BSSS')),0),'Missing',if(equals(length(body('Filter_BSSS')),1),'Found','Multiple Versions')),'"}')),
json(concat('{"type":"GL","file":"',replace(coalesce(first(body('Filter_GL'))?['{FilenameWithExtension}'],''),'"',''),'","status":"',if(equals(length(body('Filter_GL')),0),'Missing',if(equals(length(body('Filter_GL')),1),'Found','Multiple Versions')),'"}')),
json(concat('{"type":"TB","file":"',replace(coalesce(first(body('Filter_TB'))?['{FilenameWithExtension}'],''),'"',''),'","status":"',if(equals(length(body('Filter_TB')),0),'Missing',if(equals(length(body('Filter_TB')),1),'Found','Multiple Versions')),'"}')),
json(concat('{"type":"T12","file":"',replace(coalesce(first(body('Filter_T12'))?['{FilenameWithExtension}'],''),'"',''),'","status":"',if(equals(length(body('Filter_T12')),0),'Missing',if(equals(length(body('Filter_T12')),1),'Found','Multiple Versions')),'"}')),
